description: Source code for inflating/decompressing data, specifically processing literals and length/distance pairs in zlib compression. Contains functions for creating, executing, and freeing inflate codes state.

methods.name: inflate_codes_new
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new inflate codes state object with provided parameters.

methods.name: inflate_codes
methods.description: Executes the inflate codes algorithm, processing input data and producing decompressed output.

methods.name: inflate_codes_free
methods.description: Frees the memory allocated for the inflate codes state object.
